annotations.text:
Onboarding flow: Landing → role picker (renter vs host) → account created immediately, no wall. Login is for returning users.
Bold flat IKEA-style system: forest green + amber blocks, Archivo/Work Sans, thick 2–3px rules, no shadows or gradients.

Core marketplace loop: browse → listing detail → the host-side create-listing form.
Verification is a persistent, non-blocking prompt on both screens — it only hard-gates at the moment of publish or booking.
